payload.content_text: The infrastructure team and the procurement committee must decide on a platform strategy that is genuinely cost-effective over the long term, gives the organisation full control over its own systems, comes with the level of support the business actually needs when things go wrong, and does not lock the company into a relationship it cannot exit.

does not lock the company into a relatio: multi-year contract with early termination fee
